title: Looking for old glass jars for outdoor potting project
body: I used simple cotton twine as a wick and some gravel at the bottom. Growing mint, basil, and cilantro on my kitchen sill now! Let me know if you want the full step-by-step assembly guide.

title: Need leftover cardboard boxes for community garden mulch
body: We are setting up sheet mulch beds for the local school garden this weekend. Looking for unprinted corrugated cardboard. Willing to pick up anywhere within the city center!

title: Turned discarded wooden pallets into a vertical herb planter!
body: Sanded down two old shipping pallets, sealed them with non-toxic linseed oil, and mounted them on our balcony wall. Fits over 12 small potted herbs cleanly.
